hypothesis: An explicit operator-review policy can expose unresolved observations and operational alert burden without calling unlabelled alarms false positives or issuing train-control authority.
criterion: Account for every frame of the fixed 2641-frame upstream panel; report contiguous alert episodes, alert frames and exposure per minute and estimated kilometre, separate insufficient-travel denominators, retain all unresolved observations and source identities. Unknown age and target latency remain unverified.
minimum_reporting_distance_note: Reporting denominator floor, not a detector threshold or a stationary-train classifier. Short trajectories do not justify a per-km rate.
